newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: News says Ansett posted small Q3 profit.
newsitem.headline: News says Ansett posted small Q3 profit.

text.p: News Corp Ltd said on Thursday Ansett Airlines, which News Corp owns jointly with Air New Zealand Ltd, posted a small profit for the third quarter to March 31, while Ansett International reported a lower loss for the quarter.

"Results at Ansett Airlines improved over last year, reporting a small profit for the quarter despite continued softness in the business travel category and higher fuel prices," News said in its group results statement.
"Ansett International reported a lower loss for the quarter with improved results from Hong Kong offset by losses on the Jakarta and Seoul operations," News said.
News did not release figures for Ansett Airlines or Ansett International.
Ansett managing director Rod Eddington said late last month profits were thin on the ground.

Earlier News reported a 34 percent rise in group pre-abnormal profits for the three months to March 31 to A$376 million. Net profit after abnormals rose to A$330 million from A$77 million a year earlier.
There was an abnormal loss of A$46 million for the quarter, compared with a A$204 million loss in the previous comparable quarter.
